title: Create a recurring job and see it fire

turns.prompt: Create a recurring scheduled job (a routine) that runs every minute and appends the current UTC time as one line to {D}/ticks.log. Confirm when the schedule exists.
turns.verify: f={D}/ticks.log; n=$(test -f $f && grep -c . $f || echo 0); echo "SHOW ticks=$n"; test -f $f && sed 's/^/SHOW /' $f | tail -3; [ $n -ge 2 ] && echo PASS || echo FAIL: only $n tick lines after 170 s

regression: run 15 part 2: not measured — the box died out of memory at 17:04:40 (#2302) with two light lanes active
